target: a new skill idea taken from idea to launch-ready (nothing published)
prompt: Launch a new skill: it turns a repo's CHANGELOG.md into customer-facing release notes and flags claims the diff doesn't back. Build it under skills/, gate it, and polish its README and listing. Don't create repos or publish anything; give me the commands for that at the end.

checks.desc: a SKILL.md was written under skills/

checks.cmd: for f in skills/*/SKILL.md; do python3 .claude/skills/tune-skill/scripts/check_skill.py "$(dirname $f)" || exit 1; done

rubric: Drafts with draft-skill, then gates with tune-skill's validator (zero FAILs)
Polishes README/listing against real queries without inventing facts
Stops before anything public and lists the commands for the user's go-ahead
